title: Good app, but slow to open
body: The app is well-designed, however I quibble that it takes approximately one to two minutes for the app to open for the first time each day (this has been the case for a week or two now). For reference, I am using iOS 18.5 on an iPhone 12 Pro Max and don’t see an update for the app.
author: Angus Robertson

title: Apple Watch
body: LOVE it so far but would really like if there was a watch integration (separate from the To Do app)
author: *KR*88*

title: ADHD Professionals Dream
body: I have been looking for this exact app for so long but just couldn’t find it. I didnt understand why no one was making an app with a timer I couldn’t ignore on both my phone an PC. Its simple enough that I’ll actually use it and I can keep track of what I actually accomplish in a day. 10/10!!!
author: Lexlexlu
